explanation: The statement says that the function γ ↦ smoothedFundamental Γ T (γ • τ) has finite support. Both the function and its support property belong to the library: `smoothedFundamental`, `carrierH`, `mem_carrier_of_ne_zero` and `finite_moving` are its own declarations. The proof combines the library's `finite_moving` lemma (only finitely many γ move a compact set to meet another compact set) with `Set.Finite.preimage` and `Set.Finite.subset`, which are only generic glue. Mathlib has properly discontinuous action results, but they would need several steps plus the library's own carrier lemmas, so no single Mathlib declaration gives this result.
